facts.text: Cooperative education (co-op) is a hallmark of an RIT education, enabling students to gain full-time professional work experience.

sources.title: Cooperative Education | Career Services and Co-op | RIT

facts.text: At RIT, co-op is built into most programs: students alternate blocks of co-op work with semesters of on-campus study.
Students pay no university tuition or fees while working on co-op assignments.
